title: Norway grid golden reference
note: Reviewed reference list for the Electric Grid audit. Stations are OSM features (2026-05-28 production sidecar ids, checked against the live OSM API on 2026-10-10 where noted) cross-checked against NVE Nettanlegg5 (snapshot 2026-10-10). Voltage levels and degrees come from NVE line voltages and names; NVE station voltages are not used because NVE lists every Statnett station at 420 kV. Circuit counts above one are from OSM numbered circuits. Update entries when the network changes; never loosen a threshold to pass a model.

thresholdNotes.maxComponents: count; a nationwide ≥132 kV Norwegian AC model is one synchronous island once boundary buses are excluded (plan target).
thresholdNotes.minLargestComponentBusShare300kv: fraction of ≥300 kV buses in the main component; 1 follows from the single-island target.
thresholdNotes.minLargestComponentBusShare132kv: fraction of ≥132 kV buses in the main component; 1 follows from the single-island target.
thresholdNotes.minLargestComponentLoadShare: fraction of reference demand (MW) in the main component; 1 follows from the single-island target.
thresholdNotes.maxUnexplainedBridges300kv: count; every ≥300 kV bridge must cut off only allow-listed radial stations (audit B §4 P3).
thresholdNotes.maxUnexplainedArticulationPoints300kv: count; same rule as bridges for station outages.
thresholdNotes.maxUnexplainedDegreeOne300kv: count; every ≥300 kV bus with ≤1 ≥300 kV branch must be allow-listed (audit B §4 P3).
thresholdNotes.voltageClassTolerance: fraction; 400/420 kV (4.8 %) and 132/145 kV (9.1 %) are one class, 300/420 kV (29 %) are not.
thresholdNotes.maxVoltageMismatches: count of lines ending at a bus of another voltage class; transformers carry voltage changes.
thresholdNotes.maxParallelDuplicates: count of extra branches built from an already used OSM way set.
thresholdNotes.maxOffTerminalEnds: count of mapped line ends outside their terminal footprint (audit B B-03 baseline 174).
thresholdNotes.terminalPolygonBufferKm: km; 50 m capture buffer around station polygons, as in audit B snap-audit and topology prototype.
thresholdNotes.terminalPointRadiusKm: km; 250 m capture radius for point-only stations, as in audit B snap-audit and topology prototype.
thresholdNotes.maxAttachmentKm: km; generators 30 km (audit B §4 P5 acceptance); site loads 15 km and municipality loads 60 km are provisional until the model build measures its allocation.
thresholdNotes.maxAttachmentViolations: count of generators and loads beyond their kind limit.
thresholdNotes.generationTolerance: fraction per price area against NVE in-operation capacity; hydro ±3 %, wind ±5 % (audit B §4 P5 acceptance).
thresholdNotes.maxUnassignedGenerationMw: MW of generation without a price area.
thresholdNotes.loadTolerance: fraction per price area against the Elhub reference hour (audit B §4 P8 acceptance ±5 %).
thresholdNotes.nveCoverage: kV floor, km buffer and uncovered fraction; 300 m buffer and 97.4 % measured OSM agreement on the 2026-05-28 sidecar (audit B B-26), uncovered remainder being lines newer than the sidecar.
thresholdNotes.maxCuratedShare300kv: fraction of ≥300 kV line length that is curated (audit B §4 P4 acceptance 2 %).
thresholdNotes.minBusVoltagePu: pu; lowest admissible steady-state bus voltage in the AC load flow of each committed Operating Point (power-flow gate, tests/electric-grid-model-power-flow.test.ts; band 0.90–1.10 pu set by the grid overhaul brief)
thresholdNotes.maxBusVoltagePu: pu; highest admissible steady-state bus voltage in the same power-flow gate

generation.note: Installed capacity in MW of plants NVE lists as in operation, summed by NVE price area (ElspotomraadeNummer) on 2026-10-10: hydro MaksYtelse over 1,863 plants, wind InstallertEffekt_MW over 65 farms.

load.note: Metered consumption over all Elhub consumption groups (CONSUMPTION_PER_GROUP_MBA_HOUR) for the hour 08:00–09:00 Europe/Oslo on Monday 2026-01-12, the highest national weekday hour of the week 2026-01-12–18 (22,883 MW), in MWh/h ≈ MW. Replace together with the model reference hour.

powerFlowOverloads.reason: Flesaker feeds Drammen from the west at 432 MVA against the model's 406 MVA rating at 0 °C air (ambient rule). At the reference hour Drammen had −11.5 °C in darkness (ERA5); with I² linear in air temperature through FNN Table 1 (20 °C 749 A, −10 °C 930 A for 243-AL1/39 under 900 W/m² sun) the two circuits carry about 436 MVA at −11.5 °C, so the line is within its thermal limit at the hour the Operating Point represents. The conductor of this 1966 line is not published.

powerFlowOverloads.label: Heifjellet – Middagseidklumpen 132 kV cable (Øyfjellet wind farm)
powerFlowOverloads.reason: NVE registers Øyfjellet's 400 MW at one point and the model connects the farm at Heifjellet, so this internal cable carries the whole 262 MW winter output. The concession places one 140 MVA 132/33 kV transformer at Heifjellet and two at Middagseidklumpen, so in the farm the cable between them carries only Heifjellet's part; the cable rule rates it 250 MVA where the concession requires at least TSLF 1×3×1 1600 mm².

evidence.note: Øyfjellet, 400 MW

evidence.ref: MTA Øyfjellet vindkraftverk (2019-05-06), table of the anleggskonsesjon NVE 201104174-149 (2018-10-11)

powerFlowOverloads.label: Tonstad koblingsstasjon – Tonstad kraftverk 300 kV cable
powerFlowOverloads.reason: OSM maps the 0.24 km connection between the underground Tonstad power station (960 MW, five units) and its switchyard as one 300 kV cable without a circuit count, which the cable rule rates 834 MVA; at the winter reference hour the station runs at the common storage loading (815 MW), 840 MVA with its reactive output. The station exports its full capacity through several cable systems in reality; their number is not mapped.
